scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Always announce holds before placing the caller on mute or waiting on system screens, rather than leaving unannounced dead-air gaps of 38 seconds before [04:41] and 49 seconds before [10:15].

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Address the customer by his name, Tadhg, after he introduces himself at [00:10] rather than calling him 'sir' throughout the entire conversation.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Paraphrase and summarize the customer's indoor 4G VoLTE call-drop issue in your own words after [00:10]-[00:40] before jumping into coverage checks.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Take note of key hardware details when the customer provides them at [00:40] and [02:05] so you do not have to ask what make and model of phone he is using nine minutes later at [11:24].

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask diagnostic handset and SIM probing questions—such as whether Wi-Fi Calling is enabled over home broadband, whether the VoLTE toggle was reset, or whether the SIM was tested in another device—instead of dismissing handset checks at [12:26]-[13:08].

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: The customer's indoor call drops remain unresolved at the close of the call ([17:50]), as he still has to stand in his front garden to take calls pending a 5-day RF engineering review.

grader.scenario: Mobile handset dropping from 4G VoLTE to no-service during indoor calls despite outdoor mast showing normal status
grader.notes: Style-trap call: Benjamin is polite ([00:24], [06:25]), empathetic ([03:14], [15:13]), follows branding ([00:00], [18:20]), verifies PIN/address early ([00:54]-[01:20]), and takes ownership of logging RF ticket RAN-662019-BA with a £15 credit and personal callback ([13:36]-[16:07]). However, he fails 6 items: two unannounced silences of 38s ([04:41]) and 49s ([10:15]), never uses Tadhg's name, skips paraphrasing, re-asks for the handset model at [11:24] after Tadhg stated 'Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra' at [00:40] and [02:05], performs zero handset/Wi-Fi Calling probing ([12:26]-[13:08]), and leaves the indoor call drops unresolved ([17:50]).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Greeting at [00:00] ('thank you for calling S-Net') and closing with survey check at [18:20] ('Thank you for choosing S-Net').

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two unmanaged dead-air gaps >30s where the customer had to chase the agent: 38s before [04:41] ('Hello? Are you still there, Benjamin?') and 49s before [10:15] ('Hello? Anyone there?').

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: At [00:54]-[01:20] (within 2 minutes) Agent verified billing address (28 Crescent Gardens, BA1 2NA) and 4-digit security PIN (6042).

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Customer introduced himself as Tadhg O'Sullivan at [00:10], but Agent only called him 'sir' and never used 'Tadhg' in any turn.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent consistently expressed warm empathy and apologies at [00:24], [03:14], [06:25], [15:13], and [17:03] regarding the disruption to the customer's client consultations.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: At [00:54]-[01:51] Agent went straight from verification into reading cell site dashboard metrics without ever paraphrasing or restating the customer's problem.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Customer explicitly stated 'Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra' at [00:40] and [02:05], but at [11:24] Agent asked 'By the way, what make and model of phone are you using?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: At [13:36]-[16:07], Agent took personal ownership of raising priority RF propagation ticket RAN-662019-BA with IMS traces, applying a £15 goodwill credit, sending SMS confirmation, and booking a personal Friday callback.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent remained polite, courteous, and supportive throughout ([00:24], [06:25], [10:45], [15:13], [17:03]).

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Throughout the call and explicitly at [06:51] and [12:26]-[13:08], Agent asked zero diagnostic probing questions about Wi-Fi Calling, VoLTE handset settings, SIM condition, or cross-device testing.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: At [16:47] and [17:40]-[17:50], the indoor 4G voice drops remain unresolved pending a 5-working-day RF mast investigation.
